item.text:
The `/v1/files` upload endpoint accepts exactly these `purpose` values:

- `"fine-tune"`
- `"batch"`
- `"ocr"`

This is the enum specified for both the upload request and returned file object in Mistral’s [Files API reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/files). The OCR workflow also uses `purpose="ocr"` in the documented cURL example.

Therefore, your type checker is using an outdated or inconsistent SDK type definition. Update the Mistral client package; as a temporary workaround, use an appropriate type cast if the runtime accepts `"ocr"`.
